# PDF fixtures

All fixtures are generated by `generate-fixtures.js`. The printed fixtures
use the Instrument Sans font of the Aura theme, which has the SIL Open Font
License. To regenerate the fixtures, run from the repository root:

```sh
node packages/pdf-viewer/test/fixtures/generate-fixtures.js
```

The script prints most fixtures with the Chromium of Playwright. A new
Chromium version changes the `Producer` entry of these files, for example
`Skia/PDF m156`. The script replaces the date of printing and the DOM node
IDs with fixed values. The fixtures do not depend on the system fonts. With the
same Chromium version, the script therefore recreates every file byte for byte.
